verdict.rationale: Ollama ships its own first-party `ollama` CLI. The vendor documents the `ollama launch` command, which sets up and runs coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex against local or cloud models with no config files. Community users independently confirm everyday use of `ollama run`, `ollama pull` and `ollama rm` for model management. Missing for 10: a full first-party CLI command reference, and documented scripting or machine-readable output options for agent-driven automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: ollama launch is a new command which sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with local or cloud models.
